visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white short-sleeved blouse, a red tie, and a dark grey miniskirt, dances energetically on a lush green grass field. She has a red bow in her hair and smiles broadly while performing rhythmic arm movements and steps in bright natural daylight. (2) As the dance continues, a second woman in a matching uniform enters the frame, and they perform a synchronized routine. In the background, a dark green wall with the number 400 in yellow is visible, indicating they are in a baseball stadium outfield. (3) A cameraman wearing a black sleeveless shirt and holding a professional gimbal camera setup enters the shot to film the dancers from different angles. The dancers maintain their high-energy performance, pointing and waving towards the camera while moving across the grass. (4) The group of cheerleaders expands as more members join the formation. They move from standing positions into a kneeling line, creating a dynamic visual layer. Each member is dressed in the same school-style uniform with red accents, performing perfectly timed choreography. (5) The camera captures various close-up and medium shots of different cheerleaders as they take turns leading the dance movements. Their expressions are joyful and enthusiastic, frequently making eye contact with the lens and using expressive hand gestures like heart shapes and pointing. (6) The performance concludes with the entire group of cheerleaders gathered together on the field. They strike a final group pose, some saluting and others pointing at the camera, while the lighting remains bright and natural across the expansive green stadium setting.
